profile.description: Energy science leader who directs the Genesis Mission for AI-enabled scientific discovery.

web.named_query: ("Chris Wright" OR "Darío Gil") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In March 2024, speaking as SVP and Director of IBM Research, Gil argued that an open AI ecosystem could improve safety and deliver broader economic prosperity. In his December 2025 statements, Gil called for mobilizing America's science and technology ecosystem to win the AI race and described competition with China as serious. His supplied federal-role statements promote the Genesis Mission's use of AI to accelerate scientific discovery, improve energy systems, and advance national security applications.
